dataset: PROTHON ubiquitin ensemble dataset, Zenodo 7792288 v1
decision_basis: Archive is a verified structural ensemble dataset, but original per-run chronological ordering and run-to-frame mapping are not established by the inspected provenance.

time_metadata.explanation: DCD header supplies one constant DELTA=1 with NSAVC=1 and no original-run identifiers; MDAnalysis interprets this as 0.04888821 ps, not the reported 40 ps sampling. It cannot verify physical timing or replicate boundaries.

sources_examined: Zenodo API metadata and all seven archive members
Primary article DOI 10.1021/acs.jcim.3c00145, especially ubiquitin simulations methods
PlotkinLab/Prothon at d2d7fdb462f1cf1fa9294a6a77de8c0ca4e47fbf: all four tracked files
aai-research-lab/Prothon at 882e4f157d7b5db2837e2bdc5bca0ea8ef592a97: ubiquitin reanalysis, convergence scripts, related documentation and full-repository keyword search
requirements_to_qualify: Author-provided run-to-frame mapping or trajectory-assembly script specifying exact original-run boundaries
Confirmation of chronological frame order within each run and correspondence to the reported 40 ps sampling
Preferably original five separate native trajectories with their topology and time metadata
prohibited_inferences: Do not assume five consecutive 1000-frame chunks merely because the paper reports five runs and 5000 frames
Do not infer run provenance from coordinate jumps alone
Do not treat the six DCDs as six native equilibrium replicates
Do not treat DCD reader timing as original physical sampling
